description: Companies holding operator licences that the Companies House register shows in liquidation, administration or receivership, largest fleets first, with totals by traffic area and recent Gazette insolvency notices. Optionally for one traffic area. Companies only. Accounts overdue is not insolvency: use filing_watch. Each fact is dated to the register; whether a licence continues is a matter for the Traffic Commissioner.
